records.boundary: Reuters poll forecast, not official PMI result; official data due Monday.

records.boundary: 2025 annual uranium production/procurement data; structural signal, not current spot-price evidence.

claims.text: Hormuz physical transit remained below recent average and volatile.
Brent and WTI Friday settlements declined while markets weighed possible Hormuz normalization.
QatarEnergy extended Edison LNG force majeure to early November with five further cargo cancellations.
German storage injections improved as Asian LNG cargo competition softened.
Russian gasoline output was materially below estimated domestic demand after refinery outages.
Reuters poll expected China's official August manufacturing PMI to remain below 50.
U.S. total rig count held at 588 while oil rigs fell and gas rigs rose.
U.S. 2025 uranium concentrate production exceeded 2024 by more than threefold but remained small versus reactor procurement.
